# STATUS — what is implemented and what is not

Stages: ⬜ unbuilt · 🟨 built (built, untested, unseen) ·
🟧 proven (tests that go red + seen in the game) · ✅ accepted (**only the user sets this**).

**🟧 needs three pieces of evidence:** a picture (screenshot path), a number (measured, with the machine `[debian]`/`[cachy]`) and code (a test that goes red when it breaks). If one is missing it is 🟨 — doubt moves the stage down, not up (prompts/init.md §8, §9).

**Tally:** 222 ⬜ · 16 🟨 · 7 🟧 · 0 ✅ of 245 rows.

| Nape-Trefferzone (Cortex) | F-030 | 🟧 | hits at 8 / 30 / 75 m/s = 3 of 3; at 75 m/s the closest approach at any tick boundary is 0.150 m, so a position sample had nothing to find · 9.0 us per cast over 1000 casts · red-checked three ways: swept cast replaced by a position sample (8 of 8 red), cortex cast placed last (9 of 14 red), one mask for both layers (torso test red) · against a REAL solid husk at 30 m/s: cut on tick 10, 0.484 m of air, 0.00 m/s across the flight line · docs/images/f030-cortex.png sha256 951aff7b twice [debian] | 2026-08-09 [debian] — one swept cast_shape per active blade per tick, two filtered casts with the cortex layer first. Risk 2 was measured and does NOT fire: default_speculative_margin is Scalar::MAX, so update_aabb sweeps the full vel*dt. The readability half of the acceptance ('recognisable from 100 studs') is still unanswerable until Q-026. || 2026-08-10 [cachy] — THE CUT IS NOW LANDED OUT OF FLIGHT, not only out of a fall: scripts/f-flight-cut.txt reels the player UP a 30.37 m rope on the church face and cuts at tick 152 while still anchored and still climbing, 21 asserts held, exit 0, reproduced to the tick. Pictures docs/images/f030-flightcut.png (the cut), f030-flightcut-roped.png (mid-climb, 5.7 m) and f030-flightcut-ground.png (first reeling tick, 0.5 m) — the three together are the climb. Decoded, not just written: the gas bar shrinks 278 -> 274 px monotone across the 17 anchored reel ticks (2.79 px per gas unit against the log's 99.9 -> 98.2), the skyline at column 150 sinks 261 -> 360 as he rises 0.5 -> 5.7 m, crimson health reads 166/252 px = 65.9 % against health 66, and the camera kick puts a rooftop 30 px = 2.5 deg higher than a no-cut control. Two runs bit-identical, sha256 a490e4d9. THREE CAVEATS, none of them small: the cut lands at 74.70 m/s, which is vector.max_speed_m_s, i.e. the CLAMP and an artefact of B-004, not a chosen speed; the script releases the rope 5 ticks after the cut to dodge B-004's panic and it is untested whether the cut still lands once that is fixed; and per FIND-022 NO PICTURE CAN SHOW THE ROPE, because src/render/rope.rs is an empty stub — the images prove the climb by the gas ledger and the skyline, not by a visible rope |
| Hit-Stop und Impact-Frames | F-034 | 🟨 | Tick advances 20 over 20 steps while Position is bit-identical for exactly 7 ticks = round(0.12 * 60), and differs on the next · ticks inside the husk cortex at 30 m/s: 3 without the stop, 10 with it · red-checked by dropping RigidBodyDisabled: bit-identical for 1 tick instead of 7 · titan side: 0.1000 m of drift in 2 free ticks against 0.0000 m in 2 frozen ticks · docs/images/f034-hitstop.png, tick 161 of the same run as f030-cortex.png at 155, both showing pos 15.8 7.8 0.8 identical to the digit [debian] | 2026-08-10 [cachy] — MOVED BACK 🟧 -> 🟨. Everything measured on 2026-08-09 still holds, and it is not enough: B-004 shows the hit stop PANICS THE PROCESS when it fires while a rope is attached (RigidBodyDisabled removes the body from avian's island, and the joint's later removal asserts on island.joint_count > 0). That is the game's core loop — hook, fly, cut — so a mechanism proven only where no rope is attached is not proven. The 2026-08-09 evidence was taken from cuts landed out of a FALL; scripts/f-flight-cut.txt is the first file that cuts while roped and it found this in its first run. Second face, same bug: player::rope::shorten_ropes keeps shortening through the frozen ticks and pays 0.93 m back in one tick as a clamp-limited 74.700 m/s. Also still true: THE BLIND TEST WITH HUMAN TESTERS HAS NOT BEEN RUN — the row's own acceptance is not satisfiable by an agent |
